frontend: Mupen64Plus 2.6.0 (Homebrew: mupen64plus-ui-console + core 2.6.0), plugins glide64mk2 / rsp-hle / dummy audio / m64feed input
input: work/standalone/tools/m64feed.c: an input plugin that replays the retro-run script by VI frame (core frame callback), RetroPad mapped as Mupen64Plus-Next does (b=A, y=B, l2=Z); controller 1 with a Controller Pak; M64CMD_STOP at the end. --nospeedlimit, isolated --configdir and Core[SaveSRAMPath].

layout.save_dir: Core[SaveSRAMPath], default Library/Application Support/Mupen64Plus/save/ in the home folder on macOS
layout.name: Core[SaveFilenameFormat]=1 (default): first 32 characters of the ROM good name from mupen64plus.ini, a dash, the first 8 hex digits of the ROM MD5 in capitals, then .eep / .sra / .fla / .mpk
layout.written: when the game writes, and on stop

note: SAVE SUCCESSFUL to the Controller Pak; the whole 4-controller .mpk image is written (131072 bytes).
